title: Rewind Increment Configuration
statement: Given a positive number $k$ of work tapes, a designated work tape, a configuration in the run, rewind, or done phase, natural numbers $p$ and $r$, and an optional finite Boolean word $t$, the resulting configuration has state rewind carrying true exactly when $t$ is present. On the designated tape it applies the catalog tape operation at the current head position to the word consisting of $p$ zeros, followed by a one and $t$ if $t$ is present (and no further symbols otherwise); its head position is increased by $r-1$. The other tapes and configuration fields are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number of work tapes
A configuration in one of the three flag phases
caveat: The definition of the catalog tape operation is not included, so the resulting tape contents cannot be stated more concretely.
